sourceDefects.originalDraftNotes: The problems file (Word export) holds the statement (pages 1–2) and a „Proposed Solution“ (pages 3–5); its text layer drops most formulas. The solutions file theory-criteria.pdf holds the marking schemes of Problems 1, 2 and 3 of this round; only pages 3–4 (Problem 3) belong to this paper, pages 1–2 are the schemes of Problems 1 and 2 and were not used. The problem is printed as „Problem 3“ and keeps its catalogue number 3 here. Points are not printed in the statement; the part points and the total 40 are taken from the printed marking scheme. The statement's Part headings and the introductory paragraphs of Parts II and III are kept in printed order (part statementAfter). Printed items kept verbatim: the marking scheme for 1.4 writes the star temperature as T_S (the statement and the proposed solution use T_X); in 2.2 of the proposed solution p_3 ≈ 610 Pa is called „the temperature at the triple point of water“ (it is the pressure), and the heat balance is printed as ρ0 h_в L = ρ h0 λ with a Cyrillic „в“ subscript where h_w is meant; the final comparison prints „*“ as the multiplication sign (1,67 * 10^7 s); „Stephan-Boltzmann“ is kept as printed (a name); the marking scheme footnote says „in parenthesis“. In the marking scheme, 3.3's crude estimate and accurate answer are both printed; the part answer summarises both. The marking-scheme table cells are flattened onto one line each.
